Title: General availability: Azure Hybrid Use Benefit

Body.Content: Moving to the cloud is a journey many customers take in hybrid mode. With Azure Hybrid Use Benefit, Windows Server customers can run Windows virtual machines on Azure at a lower rate, which provides a significant cost savings. Customers must have Software Assurance for Windows Server to use this benefit. For more information, please visit the Microsoft Azure Hybrid Use Benefit page.
